name: Raster Algorithm for Fiber Surface Extraction
definition: Approximates fiber surfaces by extracting the 0 level-set of a signed range distance field to the FSCP (Fiber Surface Control Polygon), using a 2D range raster to reduce the number of distance field evaluations.
summary: The Raster Algorithm for Fiber Surface Extraction approximates surfaces by rasterizing a signed distance field to a 2D grid, trading geometric accuracy for significant speed improvements.
